summary: Admin Domain Closure Testing - Iteration 23. All 21 backend tests passed. Frontend admin pages (/admin/users, /admin/system-alerts) fully functional with all required features.
critical_code_review_comments: UserResponse.email is correctly typed as str (not EmailStr) to fix previous validation issue
AlertChannelConfig model properly stores encrypted secrets (resend_api_key_encrypted, slack_webhook_url_encrypted)
Admin users endpoint supports role/status/search filters and sorting
Role update creates USER_ROLE_CHANGED audit log with from/to values
Status update creates USER_ENABLED/USER_DISABLED audit logs
OPS role properly blocked from modifying users via _ensure_can_modify check
System alerts endpoint supports status/severity/alert_type/entity_key filters
Timeline endpoint returns daily alert counts
Bulk ack creates SYSTEM_ALERTS_BULK_ACK audit log
Config endpoint saves to alert_channel_configs table and returns channel_status
Simulate alert returns delivery_status showing routing and channel status

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Admin Users and System Alerts pages fully functional)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Domain Closure features fully tested: (1) /admin/users page with user listing, role change, status toggle (active/disabled), filters working, (2) /admin/system-alerts page with alert listing, filters (status/severity/alert_type/entity_key), timeline view, bulk ack, config save (resend_api_key, slack_webhook_url, alert_from, alert_to), simulate alert with delivery_status response. Role set verified: super_admin/admin/ops have admin panel access via ProtectedRoute. Delivery testing is limited since no real Resend/Slack credentials configured - channel status shows CONFIG_MISSING.

admin_users_page.list_users: GET /api/admin/users returns user list with email, role, status, is_active fields
admin_users_page.filters: search, role, status, sort_by, sort_dir filters working
admin_users_page.role_change: PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/role changes role and creates USER_ROLE_CHANGED audit
admin_users_page.status_toggle: PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/status toggles active/disabled and creates USER_ENABLED/USER_DISABLED audit

admin_system_alerts_page.filters: status, severity, alert_type, entity_key, limit, days filters working
admin_system_alerts_page.config_get: GET /api/admin/system-alerts/config returns channels status and config
admin_system_alerts_page.config_save: POST /api/admin/system-alerts/config saves config and returns channel_status
admin_system_alerts_page.simulate: POST /api/ops-alerts/simulate creates alert and returns delivery_status
ui_elements: alerts table with checkboxes and action buttons

delivery_testing_note: Resend/Slack real secrets not provided. delivery_status shows CONFIG_MISSING for email/slack channels. Endpoint response/flow behavior verified - actual delivery success requires real API keys.
